The company is listed on the BSE and NSE and is a Tata Group enterprise. Voltas excels in supply chain management and retail distribution, with a workforce of over 14,000 employees. The company's business model balances seasonal cooling demand with year-round engineering project execution. In FY 2024, Voltas reported a total income of ₹12,734 crores, with Unitary Cooling Products (UCP) contributing ₹8,160 crores, Electro-Mechanical Projects (EMPS) contributing ₹3,683 crores, and Engineering Products (EPS) contributing ₹588 crores. Voltas emphasizes ethical marketing practices, integrating digital and on-ground activations to enhance customer experiences. The company's vision is to become a full-stack consumer durables and engineering solutions company with a deeper presence in Indian homes and businesses..
